title: The Board's definitions of person and practitioner
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 2.00, whose definitions apply to 247 CMR, Person means an individual, corporation, government, governmental subdivision or agency, business trust, estate trust, partnership or association, or any other legal entity, and Practitioner means any person with prescriptive privileges as defined in M.G.L. c. 94C, § 1.
exam_relevance: Tests who can stand on the other side of a Board prohibition: a person includes a corporation or other legal entity as well as an individual, and a practitioner is identified by prescriptive privileges.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations
authority.section: 247 CMR 2.00, definitions of Person and Practitioner

common_confusions: A person under 247 CMR 2.00 is not limited to an individual; the definition includes a corporation, partnership, association, government agency and any other legal entity.
247 CMR 2.00 does not define licensee, registrant, Drug Store, nursing home or health care facility.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 2.00 on mass.gov (PDF).
